errors.text_span: 横轴（x轴）显示了三个语体类别，分别标记为“新闻”、“口语”和“小说”
errors.evidence: The x-axis displays four genre categories ("新闻", "传统文学", "网络小说", "微博"), not three. The description omits "传统文学" and "微博", mislabels "网络小说" as "小说", and hallucinates the category "口语".
The description fails to mention that each genre on the x-axis is further subdivided into "男性" (male) and "女性" (female) categories, which is a primary variable shown in the charts.

errors.text_span: 其中“小说”类别的最高柱状图达到约6500的频次
errors.evidence: In chart (a), the highest bar (for the female subcategory of Web Fiction) has a labeled total of 6783. The approximation of 6500 is inaccurate by almost 300.

errors.text_span: 其中87%被标记为特定语义分类
errors.evidence: In chart (a), the percentage label on the largest segment of the tallest bar is 85%, not 87%. The value 87% is incorrectly taken from the tallest bar in chart (b).
In chart (b), the highest bar (for the female subcategory of Web Fiction) has a labeled total of 6526. The approximation of 6200 is inaccurate by over 300.
In chart (b), the percentage label on the largest segment of the tallest bar is 87%, not 77%.
